feature: Parameter Court Batch Limit dan Court Batch Duration di menu System admin (konfigurasi saja, tidak dipakai oleh logic batch)
note: Hanya entri menu parameter generic; tidak ada code yang membaca nilainya untuk membentuk batch court application. Kemungkinan tercakup OCMS22.1 (jadwal jumlah notice per minggu); bukan bagian OCMS22.16-22.20.
note_en: Only generic parameter menu entries; no code reads their values to build a court application batch. Likely covered by OCMS22.1 (weekly notice quota); not part of OCMS22.16-22.20.

feature: Panggilan court-process/process-cpc dari NoticeUPL useEndorsement (tanpa controller di backend)
note: UI memanggil endpoint court-process/process-cpc setelah stage menjadi CPC pada alur endorsement UPL; grep di ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, thirdpartyapi tidak menemukan controller penerimanya.
note_en: The UI calls court-process/process-cpc after the stage becomes CPC in the UPL endorsement flow; grep in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi and thirdpartyapi finds no receiving controller.
